components.label: Description
value: You focus your aim on a distant target, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

Choose a creature you can see within the maximum range of a bow of your choice. If the target remains within the same 5ft space for at least 3 consecutive rounds (18 seconds), you can make a ranged weapon attack against it with the bow as part of the spell.
This attack can target a creature at the bows long range without suffering disadvantage, and you make the attack with advantage.
If the target leaves the space before the attack is made, the spell ends with no effects.
"Snipe em' Jonny" - Blake the artificer to Kevin the ranger while focusing on the hobgoblin warlord having a sit-down.
* - (A bow or crossbow of choice, a arrow (which the spell consumes))
